1.summary: fused.ai becomes a namespace; one result frame and one options object on every AI verb; provider on every verb.
1.changes:
The `fused.ai` API was rebuilt as one learn-once surface. `fused.ai` is now a NAMESPACE, not a function: `fused.ai(prompt)` and `fused.ai.text(prompt, opts)` are gone (removed, not aliased) and text is `fused.ai.text({prompt, ...opts})` — one options object, like image/video/transcribe/embed. Every verb takes an optional `provider: "local" | "claude"` and every reply carries `provider` back.

Every verb now resolves with ONE result frame: `{provider, finishReason, warnings, usage, response: {id, modelId, timestamp}, providerMetadata: {<provider>: {...}}}` plus a single verb-named payload — text → `text`; image → `images: [{path, url, mediaType}]`; video → `videos: [{path, url, mediaType}]`; transcribe → `text, segments: [{text, startSecond, endSecond, speaker?, words?}], language, durationInSeconds`; embed → `embeddings: number[][], values`. There is no top-level `model` (read `response.modelId`) and no echoed inputs at top level: the server's snapped/invented values (seed, size, steps, transcript file paths, seconds) live under `providerMetadata[provider]`. `usage` is camelCase: `inputTokens / outputTokens / totalTokens`.

Inputs: unknown options are a 400 naming the option on every verb (text included) — nothing is silently dropped any more. `onChunk` is the ONE partial-result callback on every streaming verb (a string on text, a segment on transcribe); transcribe's `onSegment` is gone. Text `images` resolve beside the calling page like every other file input. `finishReason` is `stop | length | cancelled`; `abortSignal` (a standard AbortSignal) is accepted on every verb. Sampling knobs the Claude tier lacks (`temperature`, `maxTokens`, `topP`) no longer 400 — they are dropped and reported in `warnings[]` as `{type: "unsupported-setting", setting, message}`. The `/api/ai` wire is camelCase (`systemPrompt`, `maxTokens`, `topP`; was `system_prompt`, `max_tokens`, `top_p`). The Python twin `fused_ai.*` takes `provider=` and returns the same frame.

Migration checklist for a page or .py on the old shapes:
- `fused.ai(prompt)` / `fused.ai.text(prompt, opts)` → `fused.ai.text({prompt, ...opts})`
- `res.model` → `res.response.modelId` (all five verbs)
- `usage.input_tokens / output_tokens` → `usage.inputTokens / outputTokens / totalTokens`
- image `res.url / seed / width / height / steps / …` → `res.images[0].url`, `res.providerMetadata.local.seed / …`; there is no `previewUrl` on the result
- video `res.url` → `res.videos[0].url`
- transcribe `res.duration / output / url / outputText / speakers / estimatedSpeakers` → `durationInSeconds` + `providerMetadata.local.*`; segment and word `start / end` → `startSecond / endSecond` (also inside the chunk callback)
- embed `vectors / dim` → `embeddings` + `providerMetadata.local.dim`; `values` added
- transcribe `onSegment` → `onChunk`
- direct `/api/ai` calls: `system_prompt / max_tokens / top_p` → `systemPrompt / maxTokens / topP`; remove any option the verb does not document (it is a 400 now)
- Python: `fused_ai.text(prompt)` and friends now return the frame above — read `["text"]`, `["response"]["modelId"]`, `["usage"]["inputTokens"]`
